app.title: Samuel de la Cruz G. | Software Engineer
app.description: Samuel de la Cruz G. is a Software Engineer with experience in React, TypeScript, and modern web technologies.

user.aboutMe: I started as a teenager by creating a file in my notepad with the EXE extension and the "START" command inside, then I learned HTML, CSS, and javascript, and now I'm a software developer working as a front-end developer.

experiences.description: Since June 2024, I have been working as a Frontend Developer on digital transformation initiatives focused on public services. I have contributed to the Business Opening (Apertura de Empresa) project, helping design and implement modern, user-centered interfaces that improve the overall user experience of government processes. I have also collaborated with the Passport Authority on UI/UX improvements and with Migration, participating in the co-creation of a flagship digital service and the development of internal tools aligned with institutional needs.

From January to June 2024, I served as Team Lead Frontend Developer, leading and mentoring a team of frontend developers while supporting the onboarding of new talent. I managed projects using Agile methodologies and tools such as JIRA and Bitbucket, ensuring effective collaboration and timely delivery. On the technical side, I oversaw UI development with React and TypeScript, enforcing best practices, scalability, and performance optimization. I worked extensively on Web3 solutions, including DApps and complex dashboards designed to manage projects for multiple roles such as admins, merchants, and vendors, handling large data streams and concurrent workflows.

Between December 2020 and January 2024, I worked as a Frontend Developer contributing to the development of scalable and responsive web applications. I built user interfaces from Figma designs using React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. I integrated Apollo GraphQL for efficient data fetching and state management, performed testing and debugging with Cypress.io, and collaborated on backend API development to enhance overall application functionality.

In 2020, I worked as a self-employed Software Developer, delivering end-to-end solutions for various projects. I designed and developed e-commerce dashboards, defining application flows, business logic, and reusable UI components. I built complete desktop application interfaces using Electron and developed full-featured web dashboards with Vue 2. This experience strengthened my autonomy, problem-solving skills, and ability to deliver practical, user-focused solutions.
